Multi-agent harness + SDD scaffolder (navori v0.12.3)

USAGE navori init|add|remove|adopt|configure|update|refresh|render|sync|scan|registry|doctor|status|bench|workspace|ticket|backup|migrations|preset|codex|dominio|audit|receipt|plan|spec|handoff|master|tools|gate

COMMANDS

  init  Adopt navori in the current repo (auto-detects stack, presets, quality gate)  
  add  Register a plugin in navori.config.json and optionally install its external tool  
  remove  Disable a plugin and clean up its managed blocks, sub-blocks and scripts  
  adopt  Take a hand-made .claude/ file under navori's management (preview by default)  
  configure  Modify navori.config.json sections after init  
  update  Update the navori CLI to the latest release, then run 'navori refresh'  
  refresh  Re-detect the repo, refresh config and run sync (one shot 'bring me up to date')  
  render  Render every configured engine from navori.config.json  
  sync  Sync every configured engine from the bundle, prompting on conflicts  
  scan  Re-detect workspaces in a monorepo and add new ones to navori.config.json  
  registry  Global registry of every navori repo on this machine (for 'render --all')  
  doctor  Inspect navori.config.json and report resolved state + managed blocks  
  status  Quick snapshot: config, plugins, drift, and suggested next steps  
  bench  Benchmark render over N runs and report p50/p95 (spots local regressions)  
  workspace  Manage navori workspaces (cross-repo config + tickets)  
  ticket  Manage tickets-as-files inside a workspace  
  backup  List and restore navori backups  
  migrations  List and restore init replace-mode migrations  
  preset  Manage local presets under .navori/presets/  
  codex  Codex-specific commands  
  dominio  Manage the workspace knowledge base (canonical cross-repo facts)  
  audit  Report harness tokens and adherence gaps  
  receipt  Sign or check the reviewed content receipt  
  plan  Classify, render, update and check a level-1/2 workplan  
  spec  Classify and validate a spec's tasks.md  
  handoff  Validate the implementer's handoff before dispatch  
  master  Master-plan project flow (spec 0034)  
  tools  Machine commands about external tools  
  gate  Run qualityGate.<fast|full>, or `foreign` for a registered destination repo (hooks only); full output goes to a log, stdout gets a verdict

Use navori <command> --help for more information about a command.

Adopt navori in the current repo (auto-detects stack, presets, quality gate) (navori init v0.12.3)

USAGE navori init [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --yes  Accept all detected values + render automatically without prompting  
  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory to initialize (default: current working directory)  
  --render  Render CLAUDE.md after writing config. Disable with --no-render. (Default: true)  
  --no-render  
  --workspace=<workspace>  Workspace to inherit defaults from (must exist via 'workspace init')  
  --recommended  Opinionated mode: --yes + full harness without installing external software (+gh if GitHub repo; engram already ships always-on)  
  --full  --recommended + default external providers (tgrep, acli; codegraph opt-in) + pre-commit hook + monorepo scan + strict project block  
  --lang=<lang>  Wizard language (es|en). Default: es. Skipped in --yes/--recommended.  
  --scan-monorepo  When a monorepo is detected, scan pnpm-workspace.yaml / package.json#workspaces and populate monorepo.workspaces[] with a preset per app
  --pre-commit-hook  Scaffold a local pre-commit hook that runs 'navori doctor --strict'. Opt-in; in interactive mode you're asked instead.

Register a plugin in navori.config.json and optionally install its external tool (navori add v0.12.3)

USAGE navori add [OPTIONS] [PLUGIN]

ARGUMENTS

  PLUGIN  Plugin id to add (e.g. engram). Omit with --suggest.

OPTIONS

  --suggest  Detect the stack and suggest a preset + plugins (does not install anything).
  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory containing navori.config.json (default: cwd)  
  --yes  Skip prompts, install external tool if needed  
  --skip-install  Do not install external tool (register plugin only)

Disable a plugin and clean up its managed blocks, sub-blocks and scripts (navori remove v0.12.3)

USAGE navori remove [OPTIONS] <PLUGIN>

ARGUMENTS

  PLUGIN  Plugin id to remove (e.g. tgrep) (Required)

OPTIONS

  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory (default: cwd)
  --yes  Skip confirmation

Take a hand-made .claude/ file under navori's management (preview by default) (navori adopt v0.12.3)

USAGE navori adopt [OPTIONS] <PATH>

ARGUMENTS

  PATH  File to adopt, relative to the repo (e.g. .claude/agents/mia.md) (Required)

OPTIONS

  --apply  Write to disk. Without it, adopt only previews.
  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory (default: cwd)

Modify navori.config.json sections after init (navori configure v0.12.3)

USAGE navori configure plugins|quality-gate|branch-base|pr-target|language|migrate|engines|workspace|blocks

COMMANDS

  plugins  Enable or disable plugins for this repo  
  quality-gate  Set or update the quality gate commands (fast + full)  
  branch-base  Set the base branch gates diff against (e.g. main, develop)  
  pr-target  Set the branch PRs target (gh pr create --base); defaults to branchBase  
  language  Switch the language of managed Core assets (es / en)  
  migrate  Rename retired harness/models/effort keys so the config loads again  
  engines  Add or remove target engines (claude / agents-md / cursor / copilot / codex)
  workspace  Associate this repo with a workspace (or remove the association)  
  blocks  Opt out of core managed blocks (e.g. exclude orquestacion / sdd)  

Use navori configure <command> --help for more information about a command.

Update the navori CLI to the latest release, then run 'navori refresh' (navori update v0.12.3)

USAGE navori update [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory (default: cwd)  
  --yes  Install and refresh without prompting  
  --dry-run  Forwarded to refresh: show changes, write nothing
  --config-only  Forwarded to refresh: skip the sync step  
  --cli-only  Only update the CLI; do not run refresh

Re-detect the repo, refresh config and run sync (one shot 'bring me up to date') (navori refresh v0.12.3)

USAGE navori refresh [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory (default: cwd)  
  --yes  Apply detected diffs and sync without prompting
  --dry-run  Show what would change, do not write  
  --config-only  Update config but skip the sync step

Render every configured engine from navori.config.json (navori render v0.12.3)

USAGE navori render [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory to render into (default: cwd)  
  --apply  Write changes to disk. Without it, render only previews (no files touched).  
  --dry-run  Deprecated: preview is the default now. Kept as an explicit alias for --no-apply.  
  --force  Regenerate settings.json even if corrupted or missing the $navori marker. The previous file is backed up.  
  --workspace=<workspace>  Render only one workspace by name (skips root). Requires a monorepo config with declared workspaces.  
  --json  Emit a machine-readable JSON result and suppress human output (for CI/automation).  
  --all  Render EVERY repo in the global registry (~/.navori/registry.json), not just the current one. Use after a navori bump to roll changes into all your projects at once.  
  --prune  With --all: drop registry entries whose repo no longer exists before rendering. In a single repo (with --apply): delete outputs left by engines no longer in config.engines (orphaned AGENTS.md/.codex/…), backing them up first.
  --verbose  With --all: list each changed managed block per repo, not just the counts.

Sync every configured engine from the bundle, prompting on conflicts (navori sync v0.12.3)

USAGE navori sync [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory to sync (default: cwd)  
  --dry-run  Show plan, do not write  
  --apply  Apply changes (skip interactive prompt)  
  --interactive  Resolve each CLAUDE.md block conflict: see the diff and pick keep-mine or accept-new.  
  --yes  Auto-confirm. Implies --apply. Fails with exit 1 if conflicts exist, unless --accept-new/--keep-mine already resolved them.  
  --accept-new  Resolve EVERY CLAUDE.md block conflict by overwriting your edit with the rendered version, without prompting. Destructive: requires --apply (or --yes) to write, and backs up CLAUDE.md first. Your user zone is never touched.  
  --accept-new-files  Resolve EVERY whole-file conflict (a managed file you edited that still carries its navori marker) by overwriting your edit with the rendered version, without prompting. Destructive: requires --apply (or --yes) to write, and backs up each file first. --accept-new alone never touches whole files.
  --keep-mine  Resolve EVERY CLAUDE.md block conflict by keeping your edit, applying every non-conflicting change, without prompting. Requires --apply (or --yes) to write.  
  --workspace=<workspace>  Sync only one workspace by name (skips root). Requires a monorepo config with declared workspaces.  
  --json  Emit a machine-readable JSON result and suppress human output (for CI/automation).

Re-detect workspaces in a monorepo and add new ones to navori.config.json (navori scan v0.12.3)

USAGE navori scan [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory to scan (default: current working directory)  
  --yes  Accept suggested presets for every new workspace without prompting

Global registry of every navori repo on this machine (for 'render --all') (navori registry v0.12.3)

USAGE navori registry ls|scan|add|remove|prune

COMMANDS

  ls  List every repo in the global registry  
  scan  Walk one or more directories and register every navori repo found
  add  Register a single repo by path  
  remove  Unregister a repo by path (leaves its files untouched)  
  prune  Drop registry entries whose repo no longer exists  

Use navori registry <command> --help for more information about a command.

Inspect navori.config.json and report resolved state + managed blocks (navori doctor v0.12.3)

USAGE navori doctor [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory to inspect (default: cwd)  
  --json  Output as JSON (pipeable)  
  --strict  Exit 1 when drift or an incoherent .mcp.json is detected (intended for CI gates)

Quick snapshot: config, plugins, drift, and suggested next steps (navori status v0.12.3)

USAGE navori status [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory to inspect (default: cwd)
  --json  Output as JSON (pipeable)

Benchmark render over N runs and report p50/p95 (spots local regressions) (navori bench v0.12.3)

USAGE navori bench [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --cwd=<cwd>  Directory to benchmark (default: cwd)
  --runs=<runs>  Number of iterations (default: 20)

Manage navori workspaces (cross-repo config + tickets) (navori workspace v0.12.3)

USAGE navori workspace init|ls|show|link|add-repo|set-default|render|rename|delete

COMMANDS

  init  Create a new workspace at ~/.navori/workspaces/<name>.json  
  ls  List all known workspaces  
  show  Show details of a workspace  
  link  Register the current repo in a workspace's machine-local registry (creates the workspace if missing)
  add-repo  Register a repo inside a workspace  
  set-default  Set a default applied to every repo in a workspace  
  render  Render every repo registered in a workspace  
  rename  Rename a workspace (preserves tickets, repos, defaults)  
  delete  Delete a workspace (move to ~/.navori/.trash for safety)  

Use navori workspace <command> --help for more information about a command.

Manage tickets-as-files inside a workspace (navori ticket v0.12.3)

USAGE navori ticket list|show|new|archive|unarchive|delete

COMMANDS

  list  List tickets in a workspace  
  show  Show a ticket and which repos reference it  
  new  Create a new ticket in a workspace  
  archive  Move a ticket to the _archive folder (reversible)
  unarchive  Move an archived ticket back to the active folder
  delete  Delete a ticket permanently  

Use navori ticket <command> --help for more information about a command.

List and restore navori backups (navori backup v0.12.3)

USAGE navori backup list|restore|prune

COMMANDS

  list  List available backups in ~/.navori/backups/  
  restore  Restore files from a backup snapshot to the current directory  
  prune  Delete backups past retention, then oldest-first down to the size cap

Use navori backup <command> --help for more information about a command.

List and restore init replace-mode migrations (navori migrations v0.12.3)

USAGE navori migrations [OPTIONS] list|restore

OPTIONS

  --json  Output as JSON

COMMANDS

  list  List init replace-mode migrations stored in ~/.navori/migrations/
  restore  Restore an init replace-mode migration back to the original repo 

Use navori migrations <command> --help for more information about a command.

Manage local presets under .navori/presets/ (navori preset v0.12.3)

USAGE navori preset init

COMMANDS

  init  Scaffold a local preset under .navori/presets/<id>/ and wire it into config

Use navori preset <command> --help for more information about a command.

Codex-specific commands (navori codex v0.12.3)

USAGE navori codex evaluation|profile|trust|approval|integration

COMMANDS

  evaluation  Capture bounded host observations and validate current live-evidence gaps
  profile  Prepare and exclusively claim future native profile metadata  
  trust  Approve this project's Codex hooks in ~/.codex/config.toml  
  approval  Prepare or relay a non-authorizing pending PR request  
  integration  Opt-in native host boundary for one pending PR publication  

Use navori codex <command> --help for more information about a command.

Manage the workspace knowledge base (canonical cross-repo facts) (navori dominio v0.12.3)

USAGE navori dominio init|list|show|reindex|inject|doctor

COMMANDS

  init  Create the Dominio store for a workspace  
  list  List the Dominio entries of a workspace  
  show  Print a Dominio entry  
  reindex  Rebuild DOMINIO.md from the entry files  
  inject  Emit the workspace Dominio index for the SessionStart hook
  doctor  Validate a workspace's Dominio (warnings only)  

Use navori dominio <command> --help for more information about a command.

Report harness tokens and adherence gaps (navori audit v0.12.3)

USAGE navori audit [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --by-engine  Read-only Claude/Pi comparison; --session may repeat  
  --published-from=<published_from>  Local bare fixture repository with retained reflogs; requires --by-engine 
  --consume-arm  Consume private arm; requires start/host/cwd/root  
  --include-human-content  Human content in private reports, this call only  
  --record-metadata  Bounded internal metadata from stdin  
  --repo=<repo>  Exact metadata repo  
  --root=<root>  Absolute private audit root  
  --cwd=<cwd>  Repo to audit (default: cwd)  
  --days=<days>  Last N days of marked sessions  
  --since=<since>  From YYYY-MM-DD  
  --until=<until>  Through YYYY-MM-DD  
  --session=<session>  Session id, prefix, or 'latest'  
  --json  JSON stdout; no files  
  --out=<out>  Output directory  
  --start=<start>  Start auditing this session id  
  --capture-child=<capture_child>  Exact Codex child; opted-in root log  
  --root-session=<root_session>  Exact child/metadata root session; no inference  
  --rollout=<rollout>  Exact --capture-child rollout source  
  --host=<host>  claude/codex/pi; metadata/consumption requires claude|codex; start: claude
  --stop=<stop>  Seal/report id, unique prefix, or 'latest'  
  --arm  Arm once for next repo message/session; hook consumes/starts  
  --disarm  Cancel pending arm; no start  
  --all-repos  All-repo range report with per-repo coverage  
  --snapshot=<snapshot>  Named versioned range snapshot in audit root  
  --copy-to=<copy_to>  Copy --snapshot here, relative to git root; no overwrite  
  --compare=<compare>  Compare snapshot metrics to range  
  --collect  Receive OTel until interrupted; show address/output/export env

Sign or check the reviewed content receipt (navori receipt v0.12.3)

USAGE navori receipt sign|gate|review|check

COMMANDS

  sign  Write a receipt for the current publish set  
  gate  Decide whether a milestone's or workplan phase's review cycle needs the scoped or the full gate
  review  Producer evidence for review_<feature>.json: begin before the diff, seal after  
  check  Check the current publish set against a receipt  

Use navori receipt <command> --help for more information about a command.

Classify, render, update and check a level-1/2 workplan (navori plan v0.12.3)

USAGE navori plan resume|classify|render|update|check|gate|acknowledge|escalation-reset

COMMANDS

  resume  Revalidate continuity without reviving stale guarantees  
  classify  Compute a task's complexity score and level  
  render  Render workplan_<feature>.md from its JSON source  
  update  Change an A<n>'s progress or append a decision, then re-render  
  check  Validate a workplan against its schema and R15's rules  
  gate  PreToolUse(Agent) gate for harness.planTiers (R16/R17/R19) — reads the hook payload from stdin  
  acknowledge  Record one bound user workflow escalation decision; does not approve review or protected effects
  escalation-reset  Restart the gate's rejection count for a level >= 2 feature (user approval)  

Use navori plan <command> --help for more information about a command.

Classify and validate a spec's tasks.md (navori spec v0.12.3)

USAGE navori spec classify|check

COMMANDS

  classify  Classify a spec as single (1 PR) or split (1 PR per delivery)  
  check  Validate a spec's tasks.md: milestones, criteria, coverage, vertical deliveries

Use navori spec <command> --help for more information about a command.

Validate the implementer's handoff before dispatch (navori handoff v0.12.3)

USAGE navori handoff prepare-parallel|begin-parallel|complete-parallel|finalize-parallel|attest|check|log-review|render

COMMANDS

  prepare-parallel  Bind immutable approved level-3 parallel scope  
  begin-parallel  Start the native producer's immutable parallel work interval  
  complete-parallel  Seal the native producer's own parallel paths  
  finalize-parallel  Join both producers after serial render and shared checks  
  attest  Attest delivery ownership from the native producer context  
  check  Validate impl_<feature>.json (or .md under scribeOwnsMarkdown:false) before dispatch  
  log-review  Validate review_<feature>.json and append findings with score >= 50 to findings.jsonl (deduped)
  render  Render impl_<feature>.md from impl_<feature>.json (only with harness.scribeOwnsMarkdown: true) 

Use navori handoff <command> --help for more information about a command.

Master-plan project flow (spec 0034) (navori master v0.12.3)

USAGE navori master delivery-slice|delivery-check|delivery-baseline|delivery-queue|delivery-revoke|delivery-criterion|delivery-review|delivery-present|delivery-decision|delivery-publication|init|mode|ux|template|check|advance|status|part|close

COMMANDS

  delivery-slice  Project an authorized slice into a workplan  
  delivery-check  Check delivery preparation without writes  
  delivery-baseline  Record explicit operator baseline approval  
  delivery-queue  Authorize a bounded delivery queue  
  delivery-revoke  Explicitly revoke queue authority and prior generation proof  
  delivery-criterion  Consume current host provenance or explicit manual attestation  
  delivery-review  Operator-attested technical review; CLI verifies content/receipt, not identity or QA execution
  delivery-present  Record a current technically reviewed demo identity, not client consent  
  delivery-decision  Explicit operator-attested client decision on an exact reviewed identity  
  delivery-publication  Attest release/deploy reference without executing deployment  
  init  Open, or complete, the active master-plan stage (R3, R5)  
  mode  Register the first stage's mode: template | en-curso | desde-cero (R16)  
  ux  Record the UX contract decision in phase ux: none | md | md-json  
  template  Print a master-plan template, or a filled issue (R42)  
  check  Validate the active stage, or a closed one with --stage (R50)  
  advance  Advance the active stage one phase (R8)  
  status  Show or regenerate derived master-plan status  
  part  Update a master-plan part or record acceptance evidence  
  close  Close, convert or abandon the active stage (R47, R57, R58)  

Use navori master <command> --help for more information about a command.

Machine commands about external tools (navori tools v0.12.3)

USAGE navori tools notice|session-context

COMMANDS

  notice  Emit pending tool update notices for the SessionStart hook  
  session-context  Emit the notice and Dominio sections for the SessionStart hook in one call

Use navori tools <command> --help for more information about a command.

Run qualityGate.<fast|full>, or `foreign` for a registered destination repo (hooks only); full output goes to a log, stdout gets a verdict (navori gate v0.12.3)

USAGE navori gate [OPTIONS] <KIND>

ARGUMENTS

  KIND  fast | full | probe | foreign (Required)

OPTIONS

  --force  Run even when a cached green matches  
  --index  probe: key on the index (git pre-commit)  
  --clean  probe: index, working tree and record must agree  
  --cwd=<cwd>  Project root (Default: <HOME>)
  --review-feature=<review_feature>  full: correlate this run to a review begin  
  --review-nonce=<review_nonce>  full: nonce returned by receipt review begin  
  --target=<target>  Review target branch (required with --review-feature)  
  --dir=<dir>  Review state directory (with --review-feature)
